- **Prefill pressure**: When the model requires more GPU resources than available, it scales up.  
- **Decode tail**: When the model needs more GPU resources, it scales down.  
- **KV cache transfer**: Data movement between GPU and CPU can slow down performance.  
- **GPU scheduling**: Tasks are scheduled on the GPU to optimize resource utilization.  
- **Autoscaling**: Adjusts GPU resources based on workload demands.
